repairs.quote: Passive: Shyvana's Attacks deal (1% + (1.1% per 100 bonus Attack Damage)) max Health magic damage On-Hit and reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 0.5 seconds. Active: Shyvana's next Attack strikes the target and the surrounding area dealing (10/15/20/25/30 + (110% Attack Damage) + (30% Ability Power)) physical damage. This Ability may be Recast after an Attack or short delay within the next 4 seconds. Dragon Form: Shyvana gains an additional Recast, causing her to bite the target of her next Attack dealing (15/22.5/30/37.5/45 + (165% Attack Damage) + (45% Ability Power)) true damage. Deals 10 additional damage to monsters. Maximum health damage does not affect structures and against non-champions has a minimum of 10 and maximum of 200. Dragon Form's final Recast cannot critically strike.

proposalDecisions.reason: 본문은 max Health의 소유자를 명시하지 않아 unknown으로 변경하고 기존 gap 유지.
치명타 불가 문구는 별도 damage 발생이 아니므로 attack_modifier로 변경.
